text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono achieved
a magnificent result in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome those truly precious "first three years" together,
we were taking a brief breather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or so it was supposed to be. It has already been 3 days
since Hishi Akebono brought me into the forest
to hunt for wild vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My phone's battery died long ago, and little food remains.
The forest is deep, and I can't tell east from west.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite such a despairing situation—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaay! Look, look, Trainer~!
I found them, I found buono wild vegetables~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should use it as a meat topping...
Or put it in pasta? It'd be great in a simmered dish too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. After all, it's not often
I get to spend so much time in the deep forest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I found the wild vegetables I was looking for,
so I'm just so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you're getting tired by now, aren't you?
I sure hope we can get out of these mountains soon~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, since that way and that way were no good,
should we try dashing this way next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than carelessly wearing down my stamina,
I feel like staying still might be the better choice, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, don't worry~.
If we're wrong, we can just turn right back around."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get going!
Trainer, climb on my back—I'll carry you~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"You're tired, aren't you~?
You can sleep on my back~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew what was happening, I was hoisted onto their back—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carrying a massive pile of luggage and an adult man on her back, Hishi Akebono dashed off with tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carrying a massive pile of luggage and an adult woman on her back, Hishi Akebono dashed off with tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that, the destination we finally arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I wonder where~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're in quite a pickle.
Want to just grab some lunch for now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I caught some fish in the river! So today,
we're having a wild dinner of wild herb porridge and grilled fish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an energetic spirit that made it hard to believe she'd been lost for three days,
Hishi Akebono began cooking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We'll clean the fish, wash them, salt them up, and grill them to perfection~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Filter the river water, boil it,
then add rice, water, kelp, and wild greens—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? No! It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Umm... add the soy sauce once it boils,
...wow, it smells delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
About 30 more minutes, I guess.
Please wait just a little longer, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bonfire crackled away.
The aroma of freshly cooked rice and grilled fish began to fill the air.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer. Just now, I realized
something really shocking."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm cooking,
I always end up thinking about you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "That was true today, and when you were butchering meat at the dorm the other day, and when you made sushi for everyone last week, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I wonder how Trainer would eat it~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering...
what flavor would make them the happiest...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Earlier, I was also thinking how much happier they'd be if I added this to that~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That's all thanks to you
eating so much of my cooking, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking back, I've eaten so much of Hishi Akebono's cooking over these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chanko nabe, somen noodles, grilled marinated veggies,
an Italian Christmas dinner, crystal chicken—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She served me countless delicious dishes,
always with a warm smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, having people eat my food
is something I truly love.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, but you know, seeing you eat it,
Trainer, might just be my favorite part.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That's why... I hope you'll
keep eating a lot, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Will you eat it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. What a relief~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why, dig in~☆
It's piping hot and super buono~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The grilled fish and rice porridge made by Hishi Akebono
were, as always, astonishingly delicious—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Relying on Hishi Akebono's intuition
as we walked, we managed to safely escape the forest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer.
Got a moment~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday... and the day before, and the day before that,
I think? Sorry for being so indecisive.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's not... an apology or anything, but...
I made a boxed lunch with only your favorite foods,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bento she handed me
was indeed overwhelmingly huge, and overwhelmingly warm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The weather's so nice today, let's eat outside~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The weather outside is gentle and pleasantly warm.
It's the perfect atmosphere for eating a boxed lunch.
choice_data_list: (Today's boxed lunch is sure to be exquisite too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of such things,
I followed behind Hishi Akebono.
